notes: An empty argument reaches the exact prompt-usage line.
The all branch enables all five display flags and replies with C's Okay line.
The on spelling shares C's all-flags branch and exact reply.
The off branch clears all five flags and returns without an Okay line.
The letter loop clears first, then enables only h/m/v/t/f bits; the focused test checks the resulting mask and reply.
The none input is not a special alias: it clears all flags, recognizes no letters, and still sends Okay.
